music.description: quirky comedy-gaming loop with bouncy pizzicato strings, playful marimba plucks, light percussion

sync_with_picture: ~1.0-1.5s cuts locked to gags and fake Roblox modals: BGM enters on 0:00.7 cut; cha-ching + Vine boom hit 'Rich Players Only!' modal (0:05.6-0:05.8); ghost shimmer hits rich avatar phasing through translucent Bacon Hair (0:07.6); sparkle chime hits gold tux equip (0:09.2); level-up ding hits 'UNLOCKED!' modal (0:12.2); footsteps (0:14.5), heart pop (0:15.9), and brawl slaps (0:17.3) match the chase/fight; wind + boom hit tumbleweed (0:21.0-0:21.4); error + boom hit 'LOL LOSER' modal (0:21.9, 0:23.0).
faces_and_mouths: Swapped 2D decals on R6 heads (no lip-sync): Bacon Hair wears purple shades opposite green '$' eyes (0:00.0-0:02.6), then swaps shades-off decals on beats—shocked gasp (0:07.6), smug grin in gold tux (0:09.2), sweaty panic (0:14.5), and broke frown (0:19.2).
comedic_or_emotional_timing: (1) Dry 'Bro!' at 0:00.1 + 0.2s silence (0:00.5) before 0:00.7 BGM; (2) cha-ching + Vine boom on 'Rich Players Only!' (0:05.6-0:05.8); (3) whip-fast reversal from chaotic girl-fight (0:17.3) to power-down chime (0:18.6), lonely wind (0:21.0), and deadpan baritone 'Relationship perks have expired' + Vine boom (0:21.7-0:23.0).
first_3_seconds: Loud dry 'Bro!' at 0:00.1, 0.2s silence (0:00.5), bouncy comedy BGM entering at 0:00.7 under 'Imagine if a gold digger owned Roblox!', and cash-register 'cha-ching' + Vine boom at 0:02.5-0:02.7.
ending: Hard-cuts hot at 0:23.4 (-8.0 dB sub-bass tail) over the 0:23.0 Vine boom on 'expired', contrasting sharply into the dry 'Bro!' at 0:00.1 on replay.
mix: Loud, brickwall-limited meme mix (-12.0 LUFS, LRA 2.0 LU, +0.1 dBTP) with massive sub-bass (44.6% <80 Hz from Vine booms) and crisp mid-forward TTS well above the quiet BGM.
why_the_sound_works: Dry 'Bro!' + 0.2s pause at 0:00.5 creates an instant pattern-interrupt before music starts.
Literal game/cartoon foley every ~1.2s (ghost phase, gold sparkle, footsteps, brawl, desert wind) sells each cut.
UI modals (0:05.6, 0:12.2, 0:21.9) get distinct audio grammar (cha-ching, achievement ding, error + deep 'Adam' voice).
Repeated -6.3 dB sub-bass Vine booms add physical punch without masking midrange speech.
unsure_about: Stock title of the 0:00.7-0:23.4 pizzicato/marimba loop (same track in 001, 004, 010, 016; left null).
